name: developer-mozilla
description: MDN Web Docs (developer.mozilla.org) is Mozilla's web developer documentation. This CLI searches the docs, fetches any doc page as structured JSON, lists every doc title/URL for a locale, and looks up browser compatibility data.

commands.name: search-docs
commands.summary: Full-text search of MDN documentation, 10 results per page, optionally limited to one locale

params.name: locale
params.description: Docs locale to search, e.g. en-US, fr, de, es, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-CN, zh-TW

commands.name: get-doc
commands.summary: Get one MDN doc page as structured JSON: title, summary, body sections (HTML), TOC, parents, translations, and BCD keys

params.name: locale
params.description: Docs locale, e.g. en-US, fr, de, ja

params.name: path
params.description: Doc path after /{locale}/docs/, with slashes kept, e.g. Web/API/Fetch_API or Web/HTML/Reference/Elements. Take it from a search result's mdn_url by removing the '/{locale}/docs/' prefix.

commands.name: list-docs
commands.summary: List every doc in a locale as {title, url}, ordered by popularity (MDN's quick-search index)

params.name: locale
params.description: Docs locale, e.g. en-US, fr, de, ja

commands.name: get-browser-compat
commands.summary: Get browser compatibility data (support per browser/version, status, spec URL) for a BCD feature key such as api.fetch or html.elements.details

params.name: feature
params.description: Dot-separated BCD feature path, e.g. api.fetch, api.Window.fetchLater, html.elements.details, css.properties.display. get-doc lists these keys in its browserCompat field.

notes: search-docs has no sort option. The site's sort=popularity URL parameter is not passed to the API. Each result includes a popularity score you can sort by yourself.
search-docs accepts one locale per call. The site can search several locales at once by repeating locale=; to do that here, run the command once per locale.

To get a doc's path for get-doc, take mdn_url (from search-docs) or url (from list-docs) and drop the leading '/{locale}/docs/'. Example: '/en-US/docs/Web/API/Fetch_API' becomes path 'Web/API/Fetch_API' with locale 'en-US'. The slashes in path must be kept literally.
get-doc body sections are HTML strings in body[].value.content. Category pages such as Web/HTML/Reference/Elements contain their listings as HTML tables inside those sections.
get-doc returns a browserCompat array of BCD keys. Pass those keys to get-browser-compat as the feature argument.
list-docs returns a very large array covering every doc in the locale. Prefer search-docs for targeted lookups.
The HTTP Observatory (/en-US/observatory/analyze?host=) starts each scan with a write request that was not recorded, so no command is provided for it.
The explorer was not signed in, so no signed-in user features were recorded. get-current-user works anonymously and returns null user fields.

dropped.name: get-current-user
dropped.summary: Show the current session's user info (username, subscription, settings) and geo country. All user fields are null when not signed in.
dropped.verifyNote: No session exists, so every user field is null and only geo country comes back. That is not useful site data for an agent, and the user info needs a login to mean anything.
